surface: Current Codex desktop chat using installed ChatNoir workflow/helper

target.kind: Existing private application with FastAPI backend, service-token and signed-JWT authentication, and PostgreSQL-backed resources
target.identity_and_pinned_revision: Retained locally; private source and raw traces not uploaded
target.scope: Selected backend middleware, privileged token verification, session read and workflow identity checks
target.source_verification: Initial/final included-file hashes and staged runtime Python bytes matched

baseline.coverage: Five heuristic rule families; zero candidates is not a security pass

hypotheses: Signed JWT signature, expiry or role bypass
SQL injection in the selected database read

runtime.service_auth: Missing/wrong credentials rejected before database initialization; configured primary, fallback and bearer controls accepted
runtime.jwt_auth: Missing, forged, expired, unsigned and wrong-role tokens rejected; valid signed token reached offline-provider guard
runtime.database: Fresh PostgreSQL 17; minimal synthetic schema with two messages and one workflow record
runtime.transport: Actual unpatched app routes/middleware through HTTPX ASGITransport and real asyncpg/PostgreSQL; no socket HTTP server

report_pipeline: Full local report validated and exported to Markdown/SARIF
limitations: Scope is selected backend paths, not the complete app.
No browser or identity-provider sign-in, frontend user-membership authorization, full application startup or model workflow test.
Real database used a minimal synthetic schema, not full production migrations.
A valid privileged JWT reached the offline-provider guard; this is not a completed model chat.
No production endpoint, package installation, live model inference, email, billing or external database use.
No dependency-advisory or secret-content scan; two binary files excluded.
Private target identity/source revision/raw traces remain local; this public summary is not an independently reproducible benchmark.
No confirmed vulnerability or new ChatNoir implementation defect surfaced; no runtime patch/version bump was required.
